_source: Mcl.xdm (RTD 7.0.1, FlexioCommon / FlexioMclLogicChannels) + per-package EPD enum validation (RTD/Mcl_TS_T40D34M70I1R0/autosar/Mcl_s32k344_lqfp100.epd / Mcl_s32k344_hdqfp172.epd / Mcl_s32k344_mapbga257.epd)

FlexioMclLogicChannel.description: One FlexIO logic-channel entry under Mcl/MclConfig/FlexioCommon[n]/FlexioMclLogicChannels. Each channel consumes one FlexIO timer/shifter pair identified by a unique channel+pin id pair within the array.
FlexioMclLogicChannel.uniqueness_constraint: FlexioMclChannelId and FlexioMclPinId must each be unique within the FlexioMclLogicChannels array. Duplicates are rejected by Mcl.xdm INVALID rule.

Name.description: Symbolic name for the logic channel; used as reference path tail /Mcl/Mcl/MclConfig/FlexioCommon_N/<Name>.

FlexioMclChannelId.description: FlexIO hardware channel (timer+shifter index). Must be unique within the FlexioMclLogicChannels array.

FlexioMclPinId.description: FlexIO hardware pin index. Must be unique within the FlexioMclLogicChannels array.

FlexioMclAddPinEnable.description: Enable an additional pin for this logic channel.

FlexioMclAddPinId.description: Additional pin id (used when FlexioMclAddPinEnable=true). Defaults to PIN_0. NOTE: PIN_0 shown here is the disabled-state serialization value written when FlexioMclAddPinEnable=false; the true Mcl.xdm DEFAULT is index-relative and applies only when FlexioMclAddPinEnable is true.

FlexioMclAddChannelEnable.description: Enable an additional channel for this logic channel.

FlexioMclAddChannelId.description: Additional channel id (used when FlexioMclAddChannelEnable=true). Defaults to CHANNEL_0. NOTE: CHANNEL_0 shown here is the disabled-state serialization value written when FlexioMclAddChannelEnable=false; the true Mcl.xdm DEFAULT is index-relative and applies only when FlexioMclAddChannelEnable is true.

FlexioMclLogicChannel.next_id_algorithm: Scan existing FlexioMclLogicChannels structs; new struct name = count of existing structs; new FlexioMclChannelId = first unused legal value from fields.FlexioMclChannelId.enum_values; new FlexioMclPinId = first unused legal value from fields.FlexioMclPinId.enum_values. If either legal domain is exhausted, the provider returns a blocker diagnostic instead of inventing CHANNEL_N/PIN_N outside Mcl.xdm.
